notes.title: New PUBG update lets you blow up Sanhok and reworks eight weapons
notes.content:
PUBG has been out for almost seven years already and in that time plenty has changed, from great new maps and weapons to the introduction of seasonal battle passes. For a game to survive this long though, it's not all about cramming in new toys. Sometimes you have to look back at the existing content and bring it up to standard, and that's exactly what PUBG update 33.1 has done. Bringing destructible environments to the jungle, it's time to relearn Sanhok all over again.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 27.2
notes.content:
27.2 Highlights
[previewyoutube=EY8kGdjM0nc;full][/previewyoutube]

Live Maintenance Schedule※ The times shown below are subject to change.
 PC: January 10, 12 AM - 8:30 AM (UTC)
 Console: January 18, 1 AM - 10 AM (UTC)


Map Service※ Please note that PC players can anticipate map changes every Wednesday at 2 AM UTC, while Console players can expect the same every Thursday at 7 AM UTC.
※ In Random Map regions, larger maps (8x8) have a 25% probability of being selected, while smaller maps have a 12.5% probability.

※ In Random Map regions, Rondo will be selectable during Week 1. But to provide a more efficient matchmaking experience, starting from Week 2, the system will be adjusted so that Rondo will be included in the random map pool with a 40% probability, while remaining maps will have a 15% rate each.

 Live Server - Featured Map (Map Select Regions ONLY) Rondo
 Live Server - Normal Match Week 1 Map Select: Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok / Karakin
 Random Map: Rondo (selectable) / Erangel / Taego / Deston / Karakin PC: January 10 ~ January 17
 Console: January 18 ~ January 25 Week 2 Map Select: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Paramo
 Random Map: Rondo (40%) / Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok PC: January 17 ~ January 24
 Console: January 25 ~ February 1 Week 3 Map Select: Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok / Karakin
 Random Map: Rondo (40%) / Erangel / Taego / Deston / Paramo PC: January 24 ~ January 31
 Console: February 1 ~ February 8 Week 4 Map Select: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Paramo
 Random Map: Rondo (40%) / Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Karakin PC: January 31 ~ February 7
 Console: February 8 ~ February 15
 Live Server - Ranked Ranked: Erangel (30%) / Miramar (30%) / Taego (30%) / Deston (10%)
 The map service for Ranked is updated on a season-by-season basis.

※ Please note that the features and updates described below are subject to change or removal due to issues such as bugs, in-game problems, and community feedback. The images used are intended as visual references only; the actual game may look different as the builds are continually developed and refined before release.


World: Rondo※ The following features are available only in Rondo.

New Feature: MarketRondo's Markets are now officially open for business!

Gone are the days of merely picking things up from the ground for your needs. Rondo has evolved, offering you a collection of in-game items - that is, if your wallet allows. Shop smart in the world of Rondo, where your fortune can buy more than just items; it can buy choices that'll change the fate of the match.

Collect BR Coins, purchase items at the Market, and achieve that win!

BR CoinsIn-game currency exclusively used in the Markets, where you can purchase a wide range of in-game materials.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/51b48053d514c3f9ed46a7d58efa12d9dab4ab32.jpg
 BR Coins can be collected through various methods: As world-spawn items
 As rewards for accomplishing In-Game Challenges
 By taking down Pillar Guards
 By selling your inventory items at the Market Coins can be dropped to the ground.
 Inventory weight: 0

MarketsHolds a diverse array of items, weaponry, and even a special vehicle. Transactions are made with BR Coins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3be20a79fddb9518e32f4c56e70139fa44478548.jpg Markets come in three distinct types: Grade I, Grade II, Grade III. Each type has its own unique size and design.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e7960f651a9638dd4f2772910145f7ca654da3ac.jpg
 Use the interaction key to open a page of shopping options, with each Market grade offering its own set of categories: Grade I: Item Shop and Garage or Item Shop and Random Item
 Grade II: Item Shop, Weapons Dealer, Random Item
 Grade III: Item Shop, Weapons Dealer, Random Item
 The higher the Market grade, players are greeted with higher quality items and a broader selection.
 Each weapon bought from the Weapons Dealer comes with a suitable amount of ammunition. Inventory items eligible to sell will have a BR Coin icon in the upper left corner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/580451032e83162e412fd9ce3868336e96222892.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1c77db181f428c29573ffb840dca4c9551bc16f5.jpg
 Markets and Garages are marked on the map.
 Any Market items purchased beyond your inventory capacity will drop to the ground.
 A Market can be interacted with multiple times, but each Market holds limited stock.
 There are certain conditions, like being knocked out, in a vehicle, prone, being carried, etc. under which you cannot interact with Markets.

Emergency Cover FlareA throwable for on-demand defense.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7bb6a7a9eea80897fd5a4448bb4f3da19147ab8d.jpg
 Inventory slot: Throwables
 Weight: 15
 Upon use, red smoke signals the activation, emanating from the item.
 When thrown, three sturdy Emergency Cover airdrops are deployed from the sky, which descend and land in close proximity to the flare's location within a few seconds.
 Emergency Cover airdrops can destroy bamboos and wooden fences upon impact. Players are also at risk of being knocked out or killed if one falls on them.
 Emergency Cover airdrops are immune to weapon damage, but movable by vehicles and explosives.
 The impact of Emergency Cover airdrops is capable of extinguishing flames from Molotovs and smoke from Smoke Grenades. When a Smoke Grenade is already emitting smoke, the extinguished areas will be replenished with smoke. Emergency Cover Flares may not be activated when used in confined spaces.
 Available at the Item Shop and also as a world spawn item.

Battle Ready KitA Market-exclusive heal & boost item available for purchase at the Item Shop.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8a590c54fcb53d39ae92428153831b05893cc08d.jpg
 Weight: 20
 When used, it completely replenishes both your health and boost gauge after 8 seconds.
 The Battle Ready Kit cannot be used using the usual shortcuts for heal/boost items.

GarageCertain Grade I Markets come with an associated garage, holding the exclusive Pillar UAZ vehicle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/dfd3a337857ac8c19237ee74ceec15c65f0236e4.jpg
 Once a player purchases the Garage option, an alert siren is triggered, signaling the opening of the associated garage. Players can then access the Pillar UAZ.
 Each Garage option can be bought only once per Grade I Market. Once purchased, it will be marked to indicate its unavailability.

Pillar UAZThe Market's Garage exclusive vehicle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ea7b99d7f95c4c3096e1ea011cd5aea857fe7cd0.jpg
 Health: 2500
 Max speed: Approximately 90km/h and 107km/h using boost.
 Equipped with the trunk system.
 The Pillar UAZ offers enhanced protection with its bulletproof windows and sturdy tires. Windows can be penetrated on Consoles (existing system for all vehicles). Due to the bulletproof windows, players cannot fire from inside the vehicle.
 Vehicle skins are not applicable to the Pillar UAZ.

Pillar GuardsFormidable protectors of Grade III Market locations. Don't think you can quietly pass through their area!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/852a501d3c9c80a22a9f3739709ae97947987b60.jpg
 Pillar Guards are stationed and regularly patrol the vicinity of Grade III Market locations to make sure that accessing high-quality merch remains a challenge.

SafeA safe designed to safeguard valuable items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6b4d0dfda5f6d0c8340c2d5ad79cba6d29395b1c.jpg
 Players can use the interaction key to unlock the safe and acquire Gold Bars. Gold Bar inventory weight: 15
 A Gold Bar can be traded for 1,000 BR Coins at the Market. Safes are found in buildings across the map.

In-Game ChallengesYou now have the opportunity to engage in In-Game Challenges and earn rewards in Rondo! Accomplish various objectives each match for a unique gameplay experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1df3047538ffb1197c83ade5d2ee81c17bfcfca5.jpg
Challenges
 A total of 3 challenges are given on the starting island and can be accomplished from the moment you land.
 Challenges are displayed on the left side of the world map.
 Challenges come in three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, and Hard. Rewards vary depending on the difficulty. Players with a Survival Mastery level of 80 or lower will receive two additional Newbie challenges.
 Challenges that require you to loot specific items can also be accomplished by purchasing the items from the Market. Challenges are individual, implying that your progress is not shared with your party.
 Challenge progress is indicated by a progress bar or numbers.
 You can swap your challenges up to 3 times. Completed challenges cannot be swapped. Challenges cannot be accomplished in spectator mode. However, if you return to the match through the Recall system, you can resume your challenges. If a Survivor/Crafter Pass mission and an in-game challenge overlap, you can complete both at the same time.

Rewards
 Obtainable rewards BR Coins, heal and boost items, equipment, secondary/throwable weapons, scopes, attachments, etc. Once you accomplish a challenge, the reward will be sent to your inventory. If your inventory is full, the reward will be on hold and resent 10 seconds after a message regarding your full inventory.
 If your inventory remains full upon resending, the reward will drop to the ground. The same applies when you're in a vehicle.
 Rewards are obtained the same way even when you are in the air, underwater, on Emergency Pickup, or knocked down.
 You can receive BR Coin rewards even when your inventory is full. If you obtain rewards of the following categories–equipment or secondary/throwable weapons–when those slots are empty, rewards will be auto-equipped.  If an equipment reward is of the same or higher level than your current one, it will automatically replace the existing gear. An equipment reward of a lower level will drop to the ground.
 However, an equipped secondary weapon will not be replaced. Secondary weapon rewards will fall to the ground, while ammunition will be added to your inventory if space allows.
 Secondary weapon rewards include a small amount of ammunition. Whether attachments get auto-equipped or not depends on your settings.
 All challenges, excluding Newbie challenges, have a chance to offer a Jackpot Reward, and those challenges will glow gold.
 Rewards are only available in the current match.

EMP ZoneOne day, a resounding bang echoed, leading to the formation of an overcurrent shield within Rondo. Take a bold step into the vast electromagnetic field that effectively disables most electronic devices within its reach—welcome to the EMP Zone.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c6d61404acb11e0322821207eaf39eba37c87bd9.jpg
 Once you enter the EMP Zone... The reticles of scopes will be disabled, including those of newly acquired scopes within the EMP zone. 
 All motor-based vehicles will shut down. 
 Markets, Blue Chip Transmitters, Blue Chip Towers, and Jammer Packs will be unavailable.
 Most other electronic features will be deactivated. Exceptions: C4, Stun Gun, Self-AED, BZ Grenade
 An EMP Zone warning message along with its activation area on the world map will show up.
 Will not be created after Phase 3.
 Does not inflict damage to characters, terrain, buildings, etc.
 Escalators that partially overlap with the EMP zone will also stop functioning.

Dev's Comment: The EMP Zone is making its debut in Rondo, offering a solitary experience that cuts you off from modern civilization. This Rondo-exclusive zone has been designed through an analysis of existing zones, considering factors such as activation phases and locations, durations, sizes, impact on gameplay, and effect range. Try to lay off from depending too much on electronics once in a while for a more unique experience!

Spawn ChangesThe following no longer spawn in Rondo.
 SCAR-L
 Deagle
 R45
 DP-28
 PP-19 Bizon
 Vector
 Mosin Nagant
 Quiver (Crossbow)
 3-wheeled motorcycles
 Aquarail
Corresponding to these removals, the spawn rates for other valuables such as ARs, SMGs, SRs, LMGs, handguns, magazines, 2-wheeled motorcycles, and boats have increased.


World: ErangelTraces leading to Rondo have vanished from Erangel.


Blizzard Zone & SandstormBlizzard Zone
 Frequency of occurrence has been reduced.
 Duration has been reduced by 20%.
 Impact is now limited to Phase 4, whereas its reach used to extend up to Phase 6.

Sandstorm
 The general size has been reduced.
 Sound has been slightly reduced.

Common Spec
 No longer inflicts damage.

Dev's Comment: The Blizzard Zone and Sandstorm were added to the game to diversify PUBG gameplay. However, as noted in PUBG Care Package Ep. 2, players experienced frustration due to these uncontrollable environmental elements, particularly in the late phases. As we prioritize providing an enjoyable gameplay experience, we've decided to make adjustments to the Blizzard Zone and Sandstorm based on your feedback. With these changes, we hope that players will be able to effectively leverage these environmental elements on the Battlegrounds.


GameplayKillfeed
 The team numbers are now visible in streamer mode.
 even when the "Hide Nicknames in Killfeed" option is enabled.
SocialPUBG ID{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/570535436f0bf35284f91e361ab5982e4f55b3a5.jpg
Showcase your PUBG identity with the following changes.

 PUBG ID will replace your in-game profile.
 PUBG ID will be shown on Social, Clan pages, and various other locations.

Player MemoIntroducing a new feature–Player Memo–that allows you to personally leave notes on your friends or Clan members.

 To create or modify a player memo, simply click the 'Edit Memo' button when selecting an ID from either the friends list or Clan member list.
 Only the author can view and edit player memos, and they are accessible for viewing and editing at all times.
 If a player is both a friend and a Clan member, you will find the same memo in both the Friends and Clan Members menu.
 Player memos can be written in any language and consist of a minimum of 1 character and a maximum of 16 characters, including spaces and special characters.

Miscellaneous
 A social status that shows 'in matchmaking' has been added.
 Social status icons for online/offline displays have been changed.


Custom MatchOptions for the new features introduced in the World: Rondo section have been added.


ModeTraining ModeBattle Ready Kit has been added to the Spawn Tool.


Survivor Pass: Dragon's Rise
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/785f3bf56fdce29713cdbab7e8de82206d939147.jpg
A new Survivor Pass: Dragon's Rise is prepared for the Year of the Dragon. Read more details on the January Store Update announcement!


UX/UIG-COIN Added in-game information about G-COIN status, indicating whether your G-COINs are regular or bonus and their respective expiration dates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f3116d066254ca95ee864fc289e7bced7d31cf34.jpg
 The expiration dates for both regular and bonus G-COINs are displayed. However, if the remaining time exceeds 30 days, only the regular/bonus status will be shown. The '30 days to expiration' notification has been removed from the current G-COIN expiration notifications.
 If a player possessing both regular and bonus G-COINs spends G-COINs, the G-COINs with the earlier expiration date will be used first. If the remaining periods for regular and bonus G-COINs are identical, the regular G-COINs will be used first.
 You can access the G-COIN Status pop-up by clicking on the notifications sent 7 days and 1 day before expiration.

How to Check G-COIN StatusPC
 Click on the G-COIN icon in the top right corner of the lobby to view the pop-up.
Console
 Select the "G-COIN Status" menu from the System menu to view the details of your G-COIN. 


WorkshopNew item sets have been added to the Hunter's Chest and Archivist's Chest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f5c830219c701cbf52bf0d39d62e86e2c46f913f.png
 Marine Makeover


Performance
 Optimized memory regarding character outfits.
 Optimized character animations to improve performance in crowded situations.
 Improved performance in situations where a number of buildings are visible in the distance.
 Optimized destructible bamboo logics for better performance.


Bug FixesGameplay
 Fixed the issue of abnormal character positioning when exiting a vehicle under a low ceiling.
 Fixed an issue where characters, upon experiencing a crash while moving, continue to move and become invulnerable - and once they reconnect, the character would return to the location before the crash.
 Fixed an issue where muzzle flashes appear even with a Suppressor equipped on the O12.
 Fixed an issue where gunshot reverberations do not diminish in volume after certain steps.
 Fixed the discrepancy in ADS/over the shoulder between FPP and TPP when using weapons in vehicles.
 (PC) Fixed the issue of players being moved to an abnormal location when dismounting from vehicles in blocked areas.
 (PC) Fixed an issue where getting stuck in certain objects with the Mountain Bike gets you killed.
 (PC) Fixed an issue where, under specific circumstances, the sound of distant gunfire intermittently seems to be coming from nearby.
 (PC) Fixed an issue where emergency landing planes were appearing on the Taego map in Custom Match - Esports Mode.

World
 Fixed collision, texture, performance, and some other general Rondo issues.
 Fixed an issue where using an iron door in Rondo produces a wooden door sound effect.

UX/UI
 Fixed an issue where reputation levels are not shown on the PUBG ID in Profile - Overview.
 Fixed text overlap on the match win screen in a Turkish language setting.
 Fixed an issue with wheel previews not updating and overlapping when editing Aston Martin vehicles.
 Fixed a text overflow issue in the level UI of the Survivor Pass track in Arabic and Turkish settings.
 Fixed a UI flickering issue on Career - Overview for players without Ranked records.
 Corrected the incorrect text wrapping on certain Survivor Pass level-up popups.
 (PC) Fixed an issue where the party host's nickname is replaced by the nickname of a joining player in a party.
 (PC) Fixed an issue where the reward button is disabled in a Special Drops event for certain new and returning players.
 (Console) Fixed an issue where the Confirm sound effect is missing after selecting an item in Store - Featured.

Items & Skins※ Clipping issue: Graphics that are shown outside the visible part of an image/object.
 Fixed the ankle's clipping issue when equipping the Cheerleader Sneakers with PGC 2022 Pants.
 Fixed the clipping issue when equipping a certain combinations of jackets and tops.
 Fixed the jacket's clipping issue when female characters equip the Victorian Assassin Top with the Punk Princess Jacket.
 Fixed the ankle's transparency issue when female characters equip Detective Pants with the Racy Reindeer Leggings.
 Fixed the abnormal texture display of the Panda Hairband when entering a match.
 Fixed the incorrect display of the magazine texture on the Holly Jolly Headshot - M24.
 Fixed the non-display of the identity card during the Official Business emote.
 Fixed the abnormal texture display of the legs when a female character equips the School Skirt with Racy Reindeer Leggings.
 (PC) Fixed the arm's transparency issue when switching to FPP with the Bunny Express Delivery Jacket equipped.

notes.title: End of Service for Windows 7, 8, and 8.1
notes.content:
Hello players,

Effective after January 1st, 2024, PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS will no longer support launching via all PC platforms (Steam, Epic Games Store, Kakao) on Windows 7, Windows 8, and Windows 8.1 systems.

With Microsoft's discontinuation of support for older Windows versions, our resources (including anti-cheat) have been increasingly consumed to maintain security on these operating systems. However, this effort has required a significant portion of our internal assets - therefore, to optimize our anti-cheat resources and concentrate on delivering enhanced services on modern operating systems, we have made the decision to also cease our support for Windows 7 to 8.1.

What does this mean for you?

If you're currently playing PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS using either Windows 7, 8, or 8.1, please be aware that after January 1st, 2024, the game will not be operational on these platforms. We recommend upgrading to a more modern operating system as soon as possible, such as Windows 10 or later.


 For information on identifying your current Windows version, refer to this guide.
 If you're looking to upgrade your Windows operating system, find detailed guide here.

We appreciate your understanding as we make these changes.

We hope to see you continuing your survival journey on updated platforms.

Hello players! 

Even though we're on the verge of saying goodbye to 2023, Prime Gaming drops will continue with your Battlegrounds journey. Whether you're already a Prime member or contemplating joining, make sure to visit our Prime Gaming page to explore what you can receive! 

Read on for more details!


How to Claim Rewards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/315bf29eec990110b15ad985f2de536dd498ca5c.png

 Access our Prime Gaming page.
 Click the "Claim" button below the claimable reward.
 Sign in to or sign up for an Amazon Prime account. You need an Amazon account to sign up for Prime. If you don't have an Amazon account, you can create one by clicking "Create Your Amazon Account."
 After signing up for Amazon Prime, you will be required to add a payment method. You can start your 7-day free trial first and pay the monthly payment after the trial. After you successfully set up your Amazon Prime account, you will be redirected to the reward claiming window.
 Press "Go to KRAFTON" to link your KRAFTON ID to your Amazon Prime account.
 You are required to agree to allow Prime Gaming the rights to access your game account information. After confirmation, you will be redirected to our Prime Gaming page.
 Click "Complete Claim" to receive your reward!
 Access the game and you will see your rewards automatically granted to your Inventory.

FAQ

 Do I have to be an Amazon Prime member to receive the rewards? Yes, your Prime membership must be maintained during the monthly reward claimable dates to receive the rewards. Can I cancel my Prime membership? Yes, you can cancel your membership anytime. To cancel, go to your Account & Settings page on primevideo.com and click "End Membership." I started my 7-day free trial but I got charged $1.00 USD. Amazon Prime will initially extract $1.00 USD from your bank account to confirm your payment method. The $1.00 USD will be refunded a few days later. Will every game platform linked to my KRAFTON ID receive the rewards? Yes, every game platform tied to your KRAFTON ID will automatically receive the claimed rewards! Help! I linked the wrong PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS account to my KRAFTON ID. Submit a ticket through PUBG Support and we'll assist you as quickly as possible.


Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 27.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/135f79fb41e100568c48f7fbd238f475be78d5f6.png


27.1 Highlights
[previewyoutube=KgcFTYbadEo;full][/previewyoutube]


Live Maintenance Schedule
※ The times shown below are subject to change.
[olist]
 PC: December 6, 12:00 AM - 8:30 AM (UTC)
 Console: December 14, 1 AM - 10 AM (UTC)
[/olist]

Map Service
Dev's comment: We've decided to introduce a new rotation strategy after careful consideration of player feedback regarding our map rotation system. Rotations will now vary between map selection and random map regions.

In regards to the new rotation for random map regions, Sanhok will no longer be a permanent fixture and instead, Rondo will now be available for selection within the Normal Match rotation pool. Through this update, we aim to offer players the flexibility to play the new map at their convenience - and what's important, we've reduced split queues by implementing a new feature that'll match players who select Rondo along with those who select random map selection in a single pool.

Recognizing that player preferences differ across regions, we believe implementing two distinct rotations could be more effective than our current single one. And to address some regular community thoughts that we receive, completely eliminating the rotation system or enabling all servers to choose their preferred maps will ultimately lead to affecting essential factors such as matchmaking times, which brings more challenges.

The updated system below has been shaped largely by your feedback and the preference data we've gathered so far - we're eager to hear your thoughts on this new system, so please share your feedback after giving it a try!

※ Please note that PC players can anticipate map changes every Wednesday at 2 AM UTC, while Console players can expect the same every Thursday at 7 AM UTC.

※ In Random Map regions, larger maps have a 22.2% probability of being selected, while smaller maps have a 11.1% probability.


 Live Server - Featured Map (Map Select Regions ONLY) Rondo

 Live Server - Normal Match Week 1 Map Select: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Paramo
 Random Map: Rondo (selectable) / Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok PC: December 6 ~ December 13
 Console: December 14 ~ December 21 Week 2 Map Select: Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok / Karakin
 Random Map: Rondo (selectable) / Erangel / Taego / Deston / Paramo PC: December 13 ~ December 20
 Console: December 21 ~ December 28 Week 3 Map Select: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Paramo
 Random Map: Rondo (selectable) / Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Karakin PC: December 20 ~ December 27
 Console: December 28 ~ January 4, 2024 Week 4 Map Select: Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok / Karakin
 Random Map: Rondo (selectable) / Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok PC: December 27 ~ January 3, 2024
 Console: January 4 ~ January 11 Week 5 Map Select: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Paramo
 Random Map: Rondo (selectable) / Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Paramo PC: January 3 ~ January 10
 Console: January 11 ~ January 18

 Live Server - Ranked Ranked: Erangel (30%) / Miramar (30%) / Taego (30%) / Deston (10%)
 Deston has been added to the Ranked map pool.
 The map service for Ranked is updated on a season-by-season basis.

※ Please note that the features and updates described below are subject to change or removal due to issues such as bugs, in-game problems, and community feedback. The images used are intended as visual references only; the actual game may look different as the builds are continually developed and refined before release.


New Map: Rondo
※ The following updates apply to Normal Match and Custom Match.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1cab69f251e37b6bfe65c2f655a19a0c07523692.jpg
Key Details
 Map Size: 8x8 km
 Number of Players: 100 maximum
 Weather: Sunny and Sunset
 Ascenders, Fuel Pumps, and the Recall System are available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ae85620f931a2662370eb52a46e0e19ca2388967.jpg
Prepare to be amazed by our tenth Battleground, Rondo. The long-awaited Rondo has finally arrived with Update 27.1! Boasting the most extensive playable area of any map so far, Rondo seamlessly combines traditional elements with a contemporary aesthetic.

Rondo is divided into two distinct regions, each presenting a unique atmosphere that offers either familiar gameplay or new strategic approaches.

Dive into vibrant metropolises, a floating restaurant, serene lakes, a bamboo groove, and more.

Injecting a twist into the core elements of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS - LAND, LOOT, SURVIVE - Rondo unfolds a fresh narrative with increased choices every time you embark on a new playthrough. 

※ Even more Rondo features are soon to come in future updates, starting from December 6!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f743c80b1aebdf457ae4d4b7d1e69cd95b0e132d.jpg


Main Areas
※ Please note, the following descriptions of each region are intended to depict each visual aesthetic and may not have a direct connection to the gameplay elements of Rondo.

Jadena City

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/3478d6ae65c6fe3bd05f3d6ed9f67c034339c076.jpg
This metropolis southeast of Rondo has it all: soaring skyscrapers, colorful neon signs, vibrant nightlife, and bridges that span the city. What's more, in Jadena City, you won't find yourself traversing the city with sore feet—utilize the new escalators for even swifter transitions between buildings!

※ Jadena City buildings are accessible up to the third floor.


Stadium

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/05b906c50b9ba180298bc54d558f254f29cb56a5.jpg
This dynamic stadium once mirrored the intensity of the Battleground, playing host to a diverse array of sporting events and occasional concerts.


Jao Tin

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9eea79d2d64ae7c002252839ea93d9548de43903.jpg
Surely, everyone's got a minute or two for an opera before plunging back into the fierce chicken battle.


Rin Jiang

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/cf7e3580f4155322dd478cea1ec12f39964b1cfc.jpg
In Rin Jiang, located in the southern region of Rondo, you'll discover a floating restaurant, lavish residences, and a harbor accommodating sizable ships.


Tin Long Garden

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ca857833ee4527250e6723b88dbac36a8382e8b3.jpg
Straight from the pages of a martial arts novel, Tin Long Garden exudes a nostalgic charm, featuring stunning waterfalls and massive stone mountains.

 
Yu Lin

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/fda1f41434f93bcd434ac3854dba17dc34b08f8b.jpg
Immerse yourself in the timeless beauty emanating from Eastern classical structures, embraced by verdant trees and a serene, picturesque pond.


NEOX Factory

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/038dec60742cb4684f30f1df27f50db1f738ce63.jpg
This is the automotive factory that brought Rondo's new vehicle into existence! Interestingly, they also manufacture electric vehicles.


Test Track

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/4df12ce61cb785d41bd71ba49ad56d9ee3613c4b.jpg
Introducing the testing ground where vehicles from the NEOX Factory undergo road tests. Our new vehicle also enjoyed some thrilling moments on this track.


Mey Ran

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8c2a92e83947a2bb32d8d283435bd21578490eb5.jpg
We want more than mud wrestling. Navigate yourself into lotus-filled waterways for a battle of life or death.


Bamboo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/37fd49e8766acb9f3a57e650b2e288fa03dd5215.jpg
There are many ways to relieve stress on the Battleground. Consider taking a break or engaging in some destruction.


Lo Hua Xing

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/dc813d161d6266b429f65389765668c351360015.jpg
Perched on a sheer cliff, Lo Hua Xing is guarded by formidable statues that seem poised to compel confessions of every sin at the mere sight.


Bei Li

Nowhere surpasses Bei Li when it comes to relaxation, with bamboo and tranquil waterways winding through the village.

Hung Shan

It's time to exercise wisdom in our necessities within a vast market and warehouse!

Fong Tun

Farming may look all fun and good, but make sure to remind yourself why you're on this Battleground.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a99bab0ac6c0a7dda5bdc3755ce49f592ded5077.jpg

New Features
※ Features below are available only in Rondo.

Additional Starting Planes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/5cce10f43603042e5483825246ea383fb4c01c94.jpg
Enjoy even more landing options and tactical possibilities in Rondo with two starting planes slicing through the sky!

 Multiple starting planes will be activated at a certain probability at the beginning of the match.
 Players will be assigned to one of the two planes at random.
 Parties will be grouped together on the same plane.
 The airplane path of your assigned plane will be marked on the map with a red-and-white indicator.

Destructible Bamboos
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/26fb2c116dfbf11f453ea1c6d8ba83a22309190d.jpg
Venture into the heart of the lush forest... and demolish some bamboo! Why? Because you can.

 Destructible bamboos are placed throughout Rondo.
 Destroy bamboos using throwables, vehicles, or specific melee weapons.
 Certain bamboos, such as the very thin ones, are indestructible.

Escalators
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7e54f60fd5a6701e123b38add55fe451dd6be844.jpg
A new transportation solution that'll help further swift transit over short spans like passages between buildings. Navigate and strategize within urban landscapes - make a quick escape or try to get the jump on your opponents. Get ready to "escalate" your urban combats to new heights.

 Escalators are installed at various locations in Jadena City.
 Each escalator moves in a single direction.
 Deployable items can not be deployed on escalators.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/62763823043c15cfdcb9c6db1ba1c95341ddfbca.jpg
Turntable
Add a classical touch to Rondo with our Turntables, or leave the music on to flaunt an elegant yet spooky presence.

 Turntables are placed throughout Rondo.
 Turntables are interactable with the interaction key.
 Once activated, they will play a random selection of music. A Turntable will turn off automatically after playing a single song.
 Turntables are destructible, but once destroyed, they can no longer play music.

Fireworks
Ignite some spark and vibrancy in the skies of Rondo!

 Fireworks are available on the starting island and across the map.
 Fireworks on the starting island will vanish as soon as you board the plane.
 Fireworks can be launched into the sky using the interaction key.
 Each crate of fireworks allows a maximum of five interactions, and upon each ignition, it will randomly launch fireworks a variable number of times.
 Firework crates can not be destroyed.


New Weapons
JS9
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f435e12e468c74475eac54fd991d0168a44d0db2.jpg
Introducing the JS9, a sleek and powerful submachine gun joining the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS arsenal. Chambered for 9mm ammunition, this modern bullpup-style firearm delivers outstanding damage and higher weapon stability, all while being accessible to players with varying levels of experience. Serving as a fresh addition to the pool of Submachine Guns, the JS9 is set to redefine your PUBG experience with its cutting-edge design and reliable performance. Gear up and embrace the versatility of the JS9 in your quest for chicken dinners!

 Weapon type: Submachine Guns (SMG)
 Ammo: 9mm
 Fire mode: Single, Full-auto
 Damage: 34
 Effective range: 200m
 Muzzle velocity: 400m/s
 Rate of fire: 900 RPM
 Muzzle attachment: All SMG muzzle attachments.
 Magazine attachment: All SMG magazine attachments.
 Can attach up to the 6x Scope.
 Cannot equip Foregrip/Stock attachments.
 World spawns.
 Available only in Rondo.

Dev's Comment: We're thrilled to officially unveil the JS9, with the launch of our new map, Rondo. The JS9 shares mechanics with other submachine guns but stands out for its remarkable versatility, thanks to its high damage output and relatively low difficulty.

As a world spawn weapon, the JS9 has the potential to change your perspective on SMGs, catering to both newcomers and seasoned veterans.


Stun Gun
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a8ed5bb7fca2ebc204f4631fb534023977ab0c06.jpg
When cornered by an enemy or unable to evade a confrontation, the Stun Gun may be your hero.

 A Stun Gun temporarily disorients the enemy by impairing movement and vision.
 Weapon slot: Secondary weapon
 Fire mode: Single
 Each Stun Gun can be used up to 3 times.
 If a teammate is hit by the Stun Gun, their status will be displayed on the team status bar.
 World spawns.
 Available only in Rondo.


New Vehicle: Blanc

notes.content:
Hello players!

We're introducing the new Survivor Pass: Rondo to celebrate the launch of our tenth Battleground, Rondo. We've also prepared a new look for the Survivor Pass system to make it more user-friendly, starting this Update 27.1. Learn more below!

Survivor Pass: Rondo

 Survivor Pass: Rondo ($4.99)

Sales Period

 PC UTC: December 6, After live server maintenance - January 3, 2024, 12 AM
 KST: December 6, After live server maintenance - January 3, 2024, 9 AM Console
 UTC: December 14, After live server maintenance - January 11, 2024, 1 AM
 KST: December 14, After live server maintenance - January 11, 2024, 10 AM
Important Notes

 Survivor Passes will no longer be purchasable with in-game currencies (G-COIN).
 Other bundles that include the Survivor Pass: Rondo will not be purchasable once you purchase one of the items above.
 Level up items can be used until you reach level 30, and the excess levels will be returned as 1 level items, which can be used for the next Pass.

New Survivor Pass System
Key Details

 To help you keep track of your current Pass, we're adding an always-on Pass tab to the lobby. Displays the Coming Soon track when there is no Pass in progress. With the revamped reward system, Survivor Passes now offer a range new rewards, including G-COIN, Schematics, Survivor's Chests, and Artisan Tokens.
 Survivor Passes will now be available for a duration of 4 weeks.
 Pass XP system has been rebalanced.
 Due to the adjusted duration of Survivor Pass, Pass XP obtainable from daily and weekly missions has slightly increased.
 Gameplay in Arcade modes will now count towards Daily Playtime XP. The composition of Survivor Pass has changed and the price has been reduced. Survivor Passes can only be purchased by direct payment.

Overview Page
You can have a look at the full list of Survivor Pass rewards and your progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/143d7810826c62f64b6f30a89002a4ea647cdc4c.jpg

 You can see your current level, how much Pass XP you've earned, and the free/major rewards each track offers.
 The Survivor Pass consists of 3 tracks (30 levels total) and a bonus track (10 levels).  The bonus track is unlocked after you reach level 30 and have earned all your rewards. Each track will unlock once you reach a specific Pass level, which will then let you earn the unlocked track's rewards.

Rewards Page
You can view and claim your Pass rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a7f890c5b341ef2b8f8241f045d55dd843045a4d.jpg
Details

 You can view a detailed list and preview of the rewards. Reward previews are also available for locked tracks. Once you reach level 31, you will receive one Survivor Pass Contender Medal and one Bonus Track Level Up Reward per level up.

Survivor Point
A new Survivor Points system has been added. You must earn Survivor Points to claim Pass rewards.

 5 Survivor Points are obtainable per level up. You can obtain 5 points each up to level 30, and 1 point for each bonus track level up. The amount of Survivor Points you can earn also applies to players who have not purchased Premium Pass.
 Each Pass reward requires a different amount of Survivor Points.

Claiming Rewards

 Each track is unlocked sequentially whenever you reach a specific level. You can choose to claim any reward within an unlocked track in any order.
 You are not required to claim all the rewards in a certain track to unlock the next track. You may choose to save up your points for the next track. For Premium Pass, claiming all rewards for each track offers track completion rewards. Survivor Points will not be depleted for claiming these rewards.

Missions Page
Displays daily and weekly missions that grant Pass XP, which you can use to level up your Pass.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6a773a5d2aec50963371f6df62690b7db4d4837d.jpg
 Survival time in Arcade modes counts towards your Daily Playtime XP.
 "Get an additional set of daily missions" has been removed.
 The Pass XP required to level up after completing the bonus track will gradually increase.
 The maximum level you can reach is 70.


Survivor's Chest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/74487ccb62114d5448593ddf0e29cc3cbe96a630.png

 Survivor's Chest–a new type of Workshop Chest–has been added to the Survivor Pass rewards.
 Survivor Chests contain the items that were released in previous Survivor Passes.
 Survivor Chests are bonus rewards only available in Premium Pass.


That's a wrap up for our new Survivor Pass system! This will be updated on December 6, so make sure to get your own Survivor Pass and check out all the new features. We hope this update can help you move through tracks and earn the rewards you want at your own pace!



Thank you.

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

notes.title: Dev Letter: Fortifying the Authentication System for Ranked
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e5047db847bac91c33655eff4910c688a5ae161a.jpg

Hello players.

In Patch Notes - Update 26.2, released on November 1st, we introduced enhancements to the authentication system for Ranked. For those of you curious about the background and intentions behind this change, we aim to provide in this Anti-Cheat Dev Letter a comprehensive overview of the authentication system improvements set to be implemented on November 15th.

Background

The SMS authentication system, implemented alongside the launch of Ranked in May 2021, mandated all players to confirm their mobile numbers as a measure against cheating in Ranked. Simultaneously, we prevented the reuse of mobile numbers previously used for SMS authentication on permanently banned accounts with respect to other accounts.

However, our internal analysis based on various data sources revealed that cheaters in some regions were exploiting proxy authentication techniques to access Ranked. Consequently, we recognized that the current SMS authentication system was insufficient to deter cheaters from re-entering Ranked.

In light of this, the PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Anti-Cheat Team is set to enhance the authentication system for Ranked. This enhancement to combat proxy authentication more effectively will involve 1) introducing ARS authentication and 2) requiring re-authentication with the same number.

It's important to note that these changes won't be universally applied. Instead, they will be selectively employed in cases deemed necessary to uphold a fair gaming environment and safeguard player accounts.

Further details are provided below.

Changes

Authentication System

 The following changes apply to accounts subject to the new authentication system. 
 We may request ARS authentication instead of the former SMS authentication.
 ARS authentication involves providing players with a PIN code over a phone call. Accounts previously authenticated for Ranked can still be requested to re-authenticate via ARS, which must be completed before they can play Ranked.
 Re-authentication can only be completed using the mobile number you used for your prior authentication.
 If you try to authenticate with a new number, you will not be able to proceed.
Target Accounts

 Suspected compromised accounts
 Accounts returning after a long period of inactivity
 Accounts that the system determines need re-authentication.

※ Furthermore, we will take into account other conditions that we consider vital for safeguarding your account, including alterations in your PC or connection region.

FAQ

Q. I'm not receiving a phone call that delivers a PIN code.

A. Firstly, please check if you have entered your mobile number correctly. If you have entered your number correctly, the outgoing ARS authentication number may have been blocked. In this case, please review the list of blocked numbers and proceed to unblock the number before trying the authentication process again.

Q. I was asked to authenticate with the number I used in the past, but I have changed/lost that number and can no longer use it. Will I no longer be able to play Ranked on this account?

A. In case you cannot use your previous mobile number for authentication, don't hesitate to reach out to PUBG Support for assistance. When contacting us, please provide a screenshot of the ARS authentication message shown in the example below, along with your account information. After reviewing the information, we will assist you in authenticating your new number for Ranked.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e147af25a02140563b77391f786442072121737c.png

Strengthening the Ranked authentication system is just one step in our ongoing efforts. Our commitment to creating a fairer gaming environment extends to continuous improvements and measures. Meanwhile, we will keep you informed about any future Anti-Cheat plans or changes. See you in the next Dev Letter.


Thank you.


PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Anti-Cheat Team

notes.title: PUBG Care Package EP. 2 Summary Available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b85b3f1fa5012dd1d34195534f4c086e69006bb5.png

Hello players,

As we wrap up our second live episode of PUBG Care Package, we'd like to send a heartfelt thank you for the support you've shown us during the live broadcast.

And for those who couldn't catch us live, the VOD is now available, featuring in-depth in-game insights and anti-cheat content. Don't miss it!

Below, you can also find a concise summary of the highlights.

Gameplay

Click here to watch VOD - Part 1

AUG and Dragunov

Following the rate of fire modification, the AUG's usage rate stands at roughly 29%, with a win rate nearing 53%. Given its dominant performance, we've decided to readjust its performance in the #26.2 update.

Conversely, the Dragunov displays a usage rate of around 9% and a win rate close to 45.7%. While it remains a choice pick among esports and high-tier players, our goal is to refine this weapon, making it more approachable for the broader player base.

Map Rotation

Map preferences differ significantly, not only by region but also among players within the same server. While Erangel is the preferred choice for larger maps, Sanhok's popularity sees variations across regions. Catering to such diverse tastes presents its challenges.

However, we're committed to accommodating regional preferences by adjusting the map rotation schedule. We're in active discussions about the best approach. Given the emphasis on fast matchmaking in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, options like removing the rotation system or offering every map aren't viable. Our long-term strategy is centered on enhancing the quality of each map.

Tactical Gear

Following the announcement of the updated Tactical Gear based on player feedback, we had decided against implementing it on the Live Server. Our primary motive for introducing it to the #26.1 Test Server was to collect player insights - regrettably, we acknowledge that our communication regarding this action might not have been as clear as intended.

Test Server

We acknowledge the feedback suggesting that the gap between the Test Server's launch and the Live Server update feels too tight. Additionally, we recognize concerns regarding the Test Server's download size. We're consistently re-evaluating the role and operation of the Test Server - and moving forward, we'd like to open the Test Server primarily for essential feature testing. We're also exploring methods to decrease its download size and potentially introduce a testing environment within the Live Server.

Recall System

We've observed diverse feedback regarding the Recall System. Some players find it challenging and new, while others highly appreciate it, suggesting its expansion across all maps. We're deliberating the best approach to refine this system. We're committed to closely listening to your perspectives and suggestions to improve this feature.

Sandstorm and Blizzard Zone

Numerous players have expressed concerns about the danger zones, particularly requesting for their removal from Esports and Ranked modes. In response to your feedback, we intend to decrease the occurrence of these zones after Phase 5. We're also aware of the concerns about receiving damage inside buildings and are working to address this.

Thermal 4x Scope

We've adjusted the Thermal 4x Scope to spawn solely in specific locations, increasing its rarity. However, we're still observing negative feedback regarding this scope. While a conclusive decision on this equipment has not been made, we are diligently reviewing it based on the feedback we've gathered.

Anti-Cheat

Click here to watch VOD - Part 2

Current Status of PUBG Anti-Cheat

The PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Anti-Cheat Team enforces permanent bans on around 60,000 to 70,000 accounts every week. In the first half of this year, we imposed permanent bans on roughly 1.7 million accounts, marking a 39% increase compared to the same period last year. It's essential to note that this rise in bans results from enhancements in our detection capabilities and not an upsurge in the number of cheaters. Suspected cheaters constitute about 0.33% of all players, and we are continuously enhancing our Anti-Cheat measures to combat the use of illegal software.

Regarding hardware bans, there is a misconception that they are not implemented, but this is not true. Hardware bans are indeed in place, but they might not always be immediately evident to players since we sometimes place permanent bans after temporary bans. In the meantime, we've observed consistent efforts by cheaters to circumvent hardware bans. To address this issue, we introduced our own hardware ban system through Zakynthos in May 2021. Since then, we've noticed a decline in attempts to bypass hardware bans. Moreover, with the implementation of additional countermeasures in the latter half of 2022, we've witnessed a gradual decrease in related metrics throughout the latter half of this year.

We understand that not all players may immediately perceive the impact of our countermeasures, but it is clear that we've consistently seen improvements in our metrics compared to the past. In PUBG, where a single cheater can disrupt the gaming experience for many players in a single match, the impact on individual players can be substantial. We acknowledge that there is more work to be done, and we remain committed to our mission to eradicate the use of illegal software completely.

Given the sensitive nature of Anti-Cheat where security is paramount, it's difficult to share extensive details about our work with players, as this could potentially aid cheaters. Nevertheless, we are committed to maintaining open lines of communication with our players by sharing the positive changes and enhancements within PUBG Anti-Cheat.

Anti-ESP (Fog of War)

Extra Sensory Perception (ESP), the illegal software that pinpoints other players' positions, stands as one of the most frequently encountered cheating methods that disrupt fair gameplay. In our pursuit of a more comprehensive solution, we thought that it is more important to permanently disable ESP. Therefore, we have recently taken a significant step by introducing the Fog of War system. This system effectively hinders ESP users from detecting the locations of other players. Since its implementation, we have observed a substantial 70% reduction in the attack range of ESP users.

Cheating on Console

We acknowledge that on console platforms, as well as PC, some players resort to unauthorized software or keyboard and mouse usage to disrupt the integrity of fair gaming. While we persistently impose penalties on these individuals, we acknowledge that there remain areas for enhancement in our measures. To address this, we are actively enhancing our detection capabilities, drawing insights from a diverse range of data sources.

Concluding Today's Announcement

Lastly, we'd like to address a couple of misconceptions regarding PUBG Anti-Cheat. Firstly, the notion that we are engaged in selling and profiting from illegal software is entirely unfounded. Access to Anti-Cheat-related code is rigorously controlled, even among our internal staff. This makes any collaboration unfeasible.

Additionally, there's a rumor that we selectively impose bans on players based on their level, spending in PUBG, origin, or in-game currencies. We want to make it unequivocally clear that we apply bans impartially to all players, irrespective of these factors.

For a more comprehensive discussion about Gameplay and Anti-Cheat including unauthorized programs both past and present, measures to prevent cheaters from entering the game, false bans, and our ban criteria, be sure to watch the VOD above. We'll also be keeping you updated about the state of Anti-Cheat and our forthcoming plans through our Anti-Cheat Dev Letters.



See you in the next episode!

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 26.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/224af2772e3ccca4483936ea7c45a47706ace891.jpg
26.2 Highlights
[previewyoutube=195uZC5KviY;full][/previewyoutube]

Live Maintenance Schedule
※ The times shown below are subject to change.
- PC: November 8, 12 AM - 8:30 AM (UTC)
- Console: November 16, 1 AM - 10 AM (UTC)

Live Server Updates
- Fixed an issue that allowed players to go through walls within a specific building located in Stalber, Erangel.
- Fixed an issue where other players could not see the updated Nameplate when a player uses the Human Billboard emote after changing their Nameplate.
- Fixed an issue where the start button for Custom Matches is unresponsive following certain actions.
- Fixed an issue where pressing the ESC key did not close the profile editing screen.

Map Service
※ Please note that PC players can anticipate map changes every Wednesday at 2 AM UTC, while Console players can expect the same every Thursday at 7 AM UTC.
※ In Random Map regions, larger maps have a 25% probability of being selected, while smaller maps have a 12.5% probability.

(PC) Test Server
- Normal Match: Erangel
ㅤㅤ- AS region: Squad - TPP
ㅤㅤ- NA region: Squad - FPP

Live Server - Normal Match
- Week 1: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Paramo
ㅤㅤ- PC: November 8 ~ November 15
ㅤㅤ- Console: November 16 ~ November 23
- Week 2: Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok / Karakin
ㅤㅤ- PC: November 15 ~ November 22
ㅤㅤ- Console: November 23 ~ November 30
- Week 3: Erangel / Miramar / Vikendi / Sanhok / Paramo
ㅤㅤ- PC: November 22 ~ November 29
ㅤㅤ- Console: November 30 ~ December 7
- Week 4: Erangel / Taego / Deston / Sanhok / Karakin
ㅤㅤ- PC: November 29 ~ December 6
ㅤㅤ- Console: December 7 ~ December 14

Live Server - Ranked
- Ranked: Erangel (30%) / Miramar (30%) / Taego (30%) / Vikendi (10%)
- The map service for Ranked is updated on a season-by-season basis.

※ Please note that the features and updates described below are subject to change or removal due to issues such as bugs, in-game problems, and community feedback. The images used are intended as visual references only; the actual game may look different as the builds are continually developed and refined before release.

Gunplay
Adjustments have been made for the AUG and Dragunov.

AUG
- Horizontal recoil increase: +4%
- Vertical recoil increase: +9.8%
- Recoil reduction while crouched: -16% → -13%

Dragunov
- RPM increase: 150 → 180
- Recoil recovery (aim stability after firing): +11%

Dev's comment: Back in Update 25.2, we aimed to foster a more balanced AR environment by tweaking the AUG's RPM. After monitoring the win-rate metrics post-update, we observed a minor drop in the AUG's win rate from 53.3% to 53.0% - however, this remained quite consistent with the figures prior to the RPM adjustment. Given the AUG's continuous dominance in the AR category (excluding Care Package weapons like the FAMAS and Groza) and its stats surpassing those of the Beryl M762, we saw a need for further adjustments.

Through this update, we've decided to intensify its recoil to reduce in-combat stability while preserving the AUG's distinctiveness. We've also modified the recoil reduction while in the crouched position, ensuring it doesn't provide an excessive advantage in specific scenarios.

The Dragunov, on the other hand, lagged behind other DMRs in terms of kill distribution and win rates. To enhance its usability, we've addressed the main concern our players have been mentioning - boosting the Dragunov's RPM and enhancing its recoil recovery to make it a more consistent and versatile weapon.

For an in-depth insight into the reasons behind these changes, we invite you to our next live PUBG Care Package, where our In-Game Unit Director plans to provide a comprehensive explanation. We'll also be addressing your queries in real-time during this session. For details on the live stream's agenda, date, rewards, and more, please refer to the PUBG Care Package - Episode 2 announcement.

In our ongoing commitment to provide a diverse gameplay experience that isn't monopolized by a single weapon choice, we value and invite your feedback.

Gameplay
 To better assist with strategic planning, we've added the starting plane's flight route, that'll remain throughout the match, into both the world map and minimap.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e17e0f6e2ac05aeb1dc7a575ed78c2942bc2f6ac.jpg
- On the map screen, you can toggle the plane route on or off. A shortcut key guide for this feature has been added to the same screen.
- This update applies to every mode.

World
- The 2023 PUBG Global Championship-themed decorations have been added to maps.
- KFC restaurants have been removed from Erangel, making way for the return of gas stations. Please note that the Fuel Pump feature is not available in Erangel.

Arcade
New Team Deathmatch Map: Pillar Compound
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2a32d24415d18bbcce5400b82945eafa74706648.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/31369877ff26aea0fd2e7c225b71885d62a08f6f.jpg
Introducing a new Team Deathmatch map: a hidden Pillar Compound near Deston is here to provide unique and diverse gunplay dynamics.
- The layout predominantly features a main building and side buildings.
- Several elevated areas, including most rooftops, are inaccessible.
- Ascenders are available.

Map selection probabilities have been readjusted in alignment with this update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9e67e30bd7158d29da9ecf21519add83a84eaa70.jpg

Bluebomb Rush Improvements
Enhanced Bluebomb Rush mode based on player feedback and key performance metrics.
- Markers/waypoints are now available to use on the map.
- Readjusted the defending team's starting position based on analysis showing their overly quick penetration to the central area.
- Radio Message options have been updated.
ㅤㅤ- Added a grateful and apologetic message option and removed the Save your Coins and Charge options.
- Modifications to weapon attachments purchased from the store will now be saved, and these changes will be applied to subsequent purchases.
ㅤㅤ- Attachments added to empty slots will not be saved.
ㅤㅤ- Only attachments available in the attachment crate can be saved.
ㅤㅤ- For weapons equipped with magnification scopes, even if you switch to a non-magnified scope, the magnified scope will be sustained in the next purchase.
- Updated the selection and pricing of weapons in the shop:
ㅤㅤ- The SLR has been replaced by the Dragunov.
ㅤㅤ- The M249's price has been adjusted.
- Added a new "Impressive" in-game message that'll show up when you secure a victory in one-versus-many scenarios.
- Death icons are more translucent.
- On a player's death, the primary weapon they were using will be dropped on top of their death crate.
ㅤㅤ- If no primary weapon is available, the secondary weapon will be dropped.
ㅤㅤ- The duration of death crates has been significantly extended.
- Decreased the round waiting time from 30 seconds to 20 seconds.
- Footstep sounds have slightly increased. (The audible range remains unchanged.)
- Added a leave penalty to curb unwarranted leaves during a match. Arcade points will be lost and you will not be able to participate in the match for a certain period of time.

Crafter Pass: Black Market 2023
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/269bb4779c581302b3b4b7b9d37889ff324029dc.jpg
The Crafter Pass is back, teeming with even more unique rewards and events for this month's shopping extravaganza! Read the full details in the Black Market 2023 announcement!

(Steam/Epic Games) Ranked
Fortified the verification process for Ranked. Starting from Update 26.2, any account exhibiting suspicious behavior or irregular gameplay patterns will be subject to an additional verification process.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0e6c3ffb14f546ea470763383515608f2f66efc6.jpg
Note: This update is exclusive to the Steam and Epic Games platform.
- Beyond SMS verification, you may be asked to complete an additional automated phone call (ARS) verification.
- Previously verified accounts may be prompted for re-verification. Completing this step is mandatory in order to play Ranked.
- If you've updated the mobile number linked to your account, please contact us through PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Support.
Related pop-up texts have been modified to align with this update.

Custom Match
Pillar Compound has been added to Team Deathmatch's Presets.

Lobby
The Event page has been refined.
- Renamed the page title to Event Center.
- New missions associated with Survival Mastery levels have been added.
- Standardized the display method for event rewards.

Skin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/689480698e5d0d09af1a5a2ef6a56fca89f45296.jpg
The character's hair will now remain visible after equipping a hoodie. A portion of this update was incorporated into the previous #26.1 update.

Performance
- Enhanced character animation optimization to elevate CPU performance in situations where several characters are grouped.
- When a new player launches the client for the first time, we've adjusted the default rendering size from 70 → 100 to provide a smoother gameplay experience with the standard graphic settings. Please note that this change may result in a decrease in frame rate.

Bug Fixes
Gameplay
- Fixed the issue that allowed melee weapons to pass through walls when thrown at a prone stance from a building corner.
- Fixed the issue in Training Mode where the Dragunov showed inaccurate damage indications on target hits.
- Fixed the significant distancing of the airplane route and Phase 1 Safe Zone in Normal and Custom Matches.
- Fixed the issue causing the O12 ammo to vanish when it flies beyond a specific distance.
- Fixed the issue preventing the O12 from dealing damage after zeroing adjustments with a 6x Scope equipped.

World
- Fixed collision, texture, performance, and some other general Erangel, Miramar, and Taego issues.
- (PC) Fixed the unclear visibility of character outlines on Miramar during Replay/Observer views.

UX/UI
- Fixed the issue where the notification icon does not disappear on the Match History page.
- Fixed the incorrect text casing in the Arcade lobby.
- (PC) Fixed the issue where your weapon hits are not displayed in Match History.
- (PC) Fixed the icons turning completely white when a team is eliminated in Esports mode.
- (Console) Updated the Clan and Social page's exit button label from "Back" to "Close".

Items & Skins
※ Clipping issue: Graphics that are shown outside the visible part of an image/object.
- Fixed the transparent ankle issue when female characters equipped Jijing's Shorts.
- Fixed the transparent feet issue when female characters equipped Maniacal Butcher's Shoes.
- Fixed the partially transparent Cuddle Punk Leg Warmers when equipped with Phoenix Shorts.
- Fixed the wrist clipping issue when hoodies are equipped with hats and Cammy's Gloves.
- Fixed the transparent wrist issue when the Merc Team Uniform is equipped with PNC 2023 Trailblazer Gloves.
- Fixed the transparent wrist issue when the QBZ Schematic Sweatshirt is equipped with certain shirts.
- Fixed the transparent wrist issue when Moon Lizard's Gloves are equipped with the Moon Lizard's Body.
- Fixed the transparent character or game crash issues when alternating between Bunny Academy Hazard Shoes and The Colonel's Clogs.
- (Console) Fixed the transparent ankle issue when equipping the PUBG Onesie.

notes.title: Arcade: Survivors Left Behind
notes.content:
https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/TFBq2IMM.jpg

Survive the night, craft your fight.

Haven's once radiant skyline is now overshadowed by the monstrous aftermath of Tythonic's Blue Chip.

What were once clones for mass trials have turned into the insatiable Hungers, devouring both the island and its inhabitants.

You were enlisted to clean up this nightmare, and now, just four of you remain.

Scavenge, strategize, and work together to secure your escape and survival!

General Flow
https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/PPbFuIJ2.jpg

Welcome to Survivors Left Behind. Your main goal here is to outlast the relentless wave of Hungers and escape to safety. Follow these steps to ensure your survival:

- Navigate to Arcade.
- Select Survivors Left Behind and start matchmaking.
- Once you're in with your 4-man squad, vote for the stage you wish to play.
- The stage receiving the majority of votes will begin after a countdown.
- Each stage presents varying levels of difficulty.
ㅤㅤ- The difficulty increases from Docks/Industrial Park → Residential Zone A/Industrial Park Outskirts ㅤㅤㅤ→ Steel Mill/Residential Zone B.
ㅤㅤ- Use the materials obtained in each stage to take on the more challenging stages.

https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/mfbRm8sT.jpg

- Once the stage starts, obtain basic weapons by interacting with the vending machine.
		
https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/DHR0jVkp.jpg

- Guided missions will appear on your screen's left-side - these are pivotal for your squad's getaway. Ensure each task is accomplished.
- Navigate the stage by finding the correct route while combating the Hungers.
		
https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/atwHmK0e.jpg

- Fuel the necessary Generators, power them up to unveil the exit, and make your way to safety.

https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/jkf6YXPQ.jpg

Hungers
https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/nHXLLhz6.jpg

Beware the Hungers, malevolent creatures thirsting for your lifeblood!

Here's a primer on some of the Hungers you may cross paths with:

- Prototype Hunger
- Caregiver Hunger
- Explosive Disposal Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Uses Grenades.
- Molotov Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Uses Molotovs.
- Red Zone Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Uses Blue Zone Grenades.
- Alpha Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Known for its sudden rushes from afar, this gigantic Hunger will collide into you, causing a knockback and leaving you stunned momentarily.
ㅤㅤ- Tip: If a teammate is stunned, interact with them to revive them quicker.
- Dr. Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Uses a purple chemical for its basic attack, inflicting damage akin to that of Molotovs.
ㅤㅤ- Can render certain Hungers invincible - you can only take them down by targeting Dr. Hunger directly. (Hint: Look for the end of the glowing tentacles connected to the invincible Hungers.)
- Nurse Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Possesses a harrowing scream attack, which can disorient players. If it affects you, you will have a shaky screen.
ㅤㅤ- Tip: If a squad member appears dizzy, interact to stabilize their vision.
- C4 Hunger
ㅤㅤ- Has the sinister skill to carry knocked out players, switching the attached C4 on to then self-detonate.

Hunger Meter and Status Effect
https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/AZ9IslIp.jpg

Facing the Hungers is only one of your challenges; you must also keep an eye on your hunger meter and the potential side effects if neglected.

As the stage progresses, your hunger meter will deplete. To maintain it, you must consume food.

Your hunger status will be visually represented below your health bar through color-coded indicators:

- Blue icon and gauge: Satiated
- Green: Peckish
- Orange: Starving
- Red: Depleted

Failing to address your hunger can result in a series of debilitating effects, which intensify as your hunger grows:
- Inability to sprint
- Trembling hands, impairing your aim
- Blurry vision

Cooperation is key. If a teammate is experiencing any of these conditions, interact with them to help.

Items and Crafting
https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/WRYMAHl7.jpg

Crafting is essential to escape the Hungers. Gather diverse crafting materials, use the Crafting Desk, and boost both your hunger meter and health.

While you can satiate your hunger with individual materials like cabbages, water, and cured pork, specially crafted meals offer a more substantial replenishment.

But sustenance isn't your sole crafting option. Craft items like healing items, throwables, anti-Hunger chemicals, and upgraded weapons.

Available crafting weapons are melee weapons, SMGs, and shotguns. Based on the targeted body part, shotguns carry a distinct probability to induce knockbacks or knock downs.

Regarding ammunition, each Hunger you defeat increases your stockpile.
		
https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/AK4dQeQq.jpg

Additionally, foster teamwork by sharing crafting materials with teammates. Simply drop materials on the ground for them to collect.

Recall System
Revive your fallen teammates by retrieving their Blue Chips.

Find the yellow PC terminal and interact with it to bring your allies back into the fray.

Each match, players are allowed a maximum of 3 recalls, and multiple teammates can be revived simultaneously.

Once revived, teammates will reappear in a random, safe area, holding all their items, except for ammunition, from before their demise. However, be cautious: they'll return with a depleted hunger meter.

Carry-over Items
https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/JQUvpNht.jpg

Regardless of your match result, unused materials and crafted items (excluding weapons) you have collected will carry over to your inventory for subsequent matches.

Moreover, after successfully clearing a stage, if you're lucky, you may even be able to acquire a bonus weapon or piece of armor.

Service Schedule
PC & Console: October 20, 7 AM - November 6, 7 AM (UTC)

Gameplay Settings
- Map: Haven
- FPP only
- 4-Man Squads only
ㅤㅤ- If your squad isn't full, the system will automatically match you with teammates.
- Teamkill disabled

Arcade Gameplay
- Does not provide XP or gameplay rewards.
- Will not be reflected on the Career page.
- Will not be reflected in your Match History.
- Does not support replays. 

Special Drops: Be The Last Survivor
Your mission to escape is just the beginning! Reap rewards as you progress through each stage of Survivors Left Behind.

※ Event details can be checked via the in-game lobby event page.

https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/xK82YJKH.jpg

Event Missions
- Play 1 match of Survivors Left Behind
- Clear a total of 2 stages in Survivors Left Behind
- Clear the Residential Zone B stage in Survivors Left Behind

Total Rewards

PC & Console: October 20, 7 AM - October 31, 7 AM (UTC)

Partner Drops
Don't forget to root for and observe your favorite Partners during this season to earn additional rewards!

For more information on Partner Drops and the full list of participating Partners, visit: https://pubg.com/en/events/partner-drops


- Watch at least 1 hour: Contraband Coupon (x5)

https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20231018/oJWkwbgN.png

Drops Schedule
PC & Console: October 20, 7 AM - November 4, 7 AM (UTC)

Important Notes
- Drops are exclusively available through affiliated PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Partners only.
- Rewards can only be claimed during the specified Drops period.
- To be eligible for the rewards, ensure that your KRAFTON ID is linked with your gaming platform and with Twitch or your regional streaming platform.
- For countries/platforms where Drops are unavailable, some of the rewards may be distributed through redeemable codes. Please follow the community channels for more information.

See you in Haven.

notes.title: PGC 2023 Tournament Structure Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/83aea7337d3484b50720398c1e0ddf374f83112e.jpg

Hello, PUBG Esports fans!

As 2023 comes to a close, the season's grand finale - The PUBG Global Championship 2023 approaches! From November 18th to December 3rd, 32 top-notch teams from all over the world will be dropping hot in Bangkok, Thailand. The complete list of participating teams will be available around the end of October as all regional series are completed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/13b78ab7f185719b5e378b23c032fd3c85e83fbb.jpg

We're thrilled to announce that PGC 2023 will have a live audience for the entire tournament, hosted at the Bangkok Convention Centre (BCC Hall). Keep an eye out for information about tickets and various on-site community events.

Well then, let's dive into the details of the tournament!

PGC 2023 Tournament Overview
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/05d160f6858a20e0921cbe55592652a720888f39.png
Over three intense weeks, more than 128+ players from the 32 elite global teams will battle relentlessly, aiming for the prestigious championship throne.

PGC 2023 Tournament Structure
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7b089e056a32c0d677978beeca0b8ebcdd2e857f.png
The tournament kicks off on November 18th and culminates on December 3rd. The 32 participating teams will undergo a series of stages, with only half advancing to the Grand Finals.

Group Stage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b210c1e75880333beec5ae443cecf2e349fe95d7.png
PGC 2023 takes off with a Group Stage where teams battle it out to grab a better chance for the Grand Finals. 
- Before the Group stage, the teams are divided into TWO groups: Group A & Group B.
- Each group will compete for 2 days, 6 matches per day.
- Based on the outcomes of the Group Stage,
ㅤㅤ- The top 8 teams from each group will be placed in the Winners Bracket
ㅤㅤ- The bottom 8 teams from each group will be placed in the Losers Bracket.

Winners & Losers Bracket / Last Chance
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/14910b3ceab5be085fa558b95fb029b9969523dd.png
After a day of break, the team will go through 3 stages, the Losers & Winners Bracket and the Last Chance.

Losers Bracket
The losers bracket will contain 16 teams from the bottom 8 teams of the Group Stage (Group A & B)
- These 16 teams will compete in a 12-match tournament over 2 days.
- The winning top 8 teams will advance to the Last Chance stage.
- However, the bottom 8 teams of the losers bracket will be ELIMINATED from the tournament.

Winners Bracket
The Winners Bracket will contain 16 teams from the top 8 teams of the Group Stage (Group A & B)
- The Winners Bracket will consist of 12 matches over 2 days.
- The rewards for the winners of the group stage are huge. The top 8 teams in the Winners bracket will be granted a seat directly to the Grand Finals. 
- The remaining 8 teams will be placed into the Last Chance stage for their last shot.

Last Chance
Here, as you can expect, the teams will be given their final chance to secure their tickets to the Grand Finals.
- The Last Chance stage will consist of 12 matches over 2 days.
- The winning top 8 teams will acquire the last 8 tickets to the Grand Finals.
- However, the bottom 8 teams will be ELIMINATED from the tournament.

Grand Finals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d7cc2f72c3946bf3694556c3dc5ac7d7b29d9857.png
Commencing on December 1st, the remaining 16 teams will stretch their boundaries in the ultimate showdown. Spread across 3 days with 6 matches daily, the top-performing team will be crowned the Champions of the PUBG GLOBAL CHAMPIONSHIP 2023.

Prize Pool
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8a2a163e99830c9c7d130b090aa1af98c782a640.png
PGC 2023 boasts an initial prize pool of $2,000,000. Thanks to our crowdfunding initiative and the upcoming PGC 2023 Pickem Challenge, this amount will see a surge. The final prize pool will be distributed based on the tournament's concluding rankings.

Special Prize
The MVP of the tournament will be granted an extra prize of $10,000.


PGC 2023 Profit Shares
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e28e515c6519dea9dd1d34c081d4144d7b6253a4.png
All participating teams will benefit from 25% of PGC 2023 Skin sales, reflecting their end-tournament standings. More news on the upcoming PGC 2023 Pickem Challenge will be revealed later on. So, stay tuned and do not miss your chance to acquire unique PGC 2023 skins while supporting your favorite teams!


For the latest PUBG Esports updates, visit pubgesports.com and follow @pubgesports on social media.
